Prompt 8 builds the infrastructure backbone that makes Torgima reliable at production scale. This includes: the complete event system with idempotency enforcement (every event runs exactly once), dead letter queue for failed events, multi-stage event pipeline, system health engine that monitors all components, EIS full activation with nightly web research for every user, background validation workers that run continuously, and the source-of-truth priority hierarchy that defines what data wins when systems conflict. When Prompt 8 is complete, Torgima can handle real user traffic without data corruption, event duplication, or silent failures.

The event system processes state changes but never initiates signal calculations or condition assignments directly. Events carry payloads that downstream engines process. The Signal Engine and Condition Engine remain the sole calculators.
Dead letter queue items are logged and reviewed — they do not auto-retry with different data. Retries use the original event payload. Manual intervention is required for data-mutation retries.
Source-of-truth hierarchy: SignalRecord (most trusted) > ConditionRecord > WorldModel > BhudhiLog. When systems conflict, higher-trust source wins. Bhudhi cannot override higher-trust sources.
sourceEngine String // Which engine emitted this event

retryCount Int // How many times it was attempted
result Json? // Stored result (for safe replay)
expiresAt DateTime // TTL: 24h for most, 7d for critical
dlqSize Int @default(0) // Dead letter queue size
staleUsers Int @default(0) // Users with no active order > 48h
